notes.title: New Update, Heroes!
notes.content: Hey folks! Just a quick note to say that a new version of Mission: It's Complicated should now be available. This update should fix the (rare) bug a few folks have run into with bad saves giving them a white screen they can't move past. You should once again be able to start the game -- if you still can't, please let us know!
